doors.basis: seat_wave_a 2026-10-08: map.uniqlo.com read 11 Oct, 89 open stores (4 coming soon excluded); Fast Retailing reports 87 as of 30 Sep 2026, the locator is the source

cities: 89 stores across the US, including New York, Boston, Brooklyn · its own site

craft_evidence.owned: NC. Not established: the Fast Retailing pages that would show it (factory list, company profile) errored on fetch. No product page read names an owned facility.
craft_evidence.makers: None. 0 of 66 product-detail records name a factory or maker. Fast Retailing reportedly publishes a core factory list, but its page errored and was not read.
craft_evidence.mills: Evidence, isolated: Slim Straight Jeans (E482856) page says "Fabric jointly developed with Kaihara"; AirSense Pants and AirSense Shorts say the fabric is jointly developed by Toray and UNIQLO; the Pocketable UV Protection Parka names Toray's NANODESIGN. 3-4 of 66 pages name a mill or fibre maker.
craft_evidence.heritage: NC for the founding (Fast Retailing history pages errored). The FR North America page is dated: USA "First Store Opening: September 15, 2005".
craft_evidence.process: Claim-level: pages describe what the fabric does (HEATTECH "Heat of Absorption and HEAT RETENTION", BLOCKTECH "Wind-resistant and water-resistant", AIRism) and some fibre specs ("19.5-micron wool", "e
craft_evidence.reasoning: All 66 product-detail records give only "Imported" in the composition text, though each carries country codes (mostly VN, BD, KH, CN). No maker is named. Kaihara and Toray co-development appear on 3-4 pages only. Nothing owned or documented was verified, so this is a 2. A 3 would need the Fast Retailing factory list (not read) to count as named makers.
